title: Orientation and the rules of the house
objective: You understand how training works and can apply the Ten Golden Rules.

title: How money moves
objective: You can explain payments, switches, gateways, Libyan money, how computers talk and how trust works.

title: The platform map
objective: You know the platform's parts, the merchant-application-wallet-link chain, roles and confidentiality.

title: Governance: the two-person rule
objective: You can act as a safe maker or checker and write a real reason.

title: Merchants and onboarding
objective: You can review a join request, handle KYB and help merchants without leaking secrets.

title: Payments in operation
objective: You can read any payment, handle UNKNOWN and answer customers correctly.

title: Money and the ledger
objective: You can read and build journal entries and handle reconciliation, cash-outs, adjustments and disputes.

title: AML and confidentiality
objective: You can explain AML, decide screening matches, handle cases and never tip off.

title: Gateways, rails and the engine
objective: You can configure and review a gateway safely.

title: When things go wrong
objective: You can follow the runbooks, hand over and report mistakes.

title: Security and deployment
objective: You can resist social engineering, handle data and understand the deployment model.
